The '''Biskar system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the [[Biskaran Pirates]].<ref name="TEGtW" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Biskar system was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square K-14.<ref name="EAOC" />
